summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend validation for new configurable alert thresholds in Settings, including persistence, validation rules, collector-driven alert behavior, dashboard visibility filtering, audit logging, and auth-protected settings flow.

ui_bugs.issue: After logout, login card can still show stale status text ('Settings and audit logs loaded'), which is confusing for signed-out state.

action_items: Reset/normalize settings status message on logout so the login screen reflects signed-out context.
Optional refactor: split backend/app/repository.py into smaller modules (file is >700 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/repository.py is 800+ lines and mixes settings, alerts, auth, collector, and analytics responsibilities; split to improve maintainability and reduce regression risk.
frontend/src/types.ts AlertEvent omits metric_type and metric_value fields currently returned by backend /api/alerts; consider adding for stronger type-safety around threshold-aware UI behavior.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used: admin@badger.local / BadgerPass123!
seed_data_creation: No manual seed data created; existing seeded dataset used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file added specifically for threshold enhancement coverage. Frontend automation confirmed strict thresholds can reduce visible alerts to 0 and permissive thresholds increase visible alerts (observed 12) after manual collector runs. Script ended on settings login page after logout.
rca of the issue: UI stale status message comes from shared status state reused across auth/settings flows; when navigating back to login after logout, prior success state may still be rendered instead of a neutral signed-out message.
